summary: User believed BTC was sent to an Ethereum address on Trezor but the exchange sent wrapped BTC on BNB Smart Chain to the same style address and the asset was not visible until the correct network was enabled.
user_mistake: Did not verify which blockchain network the exchange used before sending funds
prevention: Verify the selected withdrawal network on the exchange matches the intended wallet network / Check the transaction on a block explorer to confirm the chain before assuming loss
